title: How did rates move around policy speeches?
summary: ECB median 1Y OIS changes were +0.57 versus +0.02 bp for hawkish versus dovish language. German 2Y changes were +1.10 versus +0.03 bp. The 2s10s medians were +0.10 versus +0.20 bp.
Across the wider Fed daily window, median US 2Y changes were +2.00 versus +0.00 bp. The pre-speech 2Y changes were +0.50 versus -0.50 bp.
methods: The primary window covers calendar years 2000 through 2025. Sample counts use event dates within that period.
Direction is read from reviewed official speech text. Scores +1 and +2 are hawkish, −1 and −2 dovish, and zero indicates explicit support for the existing stance. Unscored texts are excluded.
Medians and the 25th and 75th percentiles describe the selected speeches. Each asset reports its own sample size. Economic-cycle labels use retrospective CEPR–EABCN and NBER contraction dates.
A level of guidance can repeat the existing message. Market participants may already have incorporated it. Timing, selection and concurrent releases limit causal interpretation.

panels.label: ECB speeches and hearings · intraday
panels.description: Changes between median quotes 20–10 minutes before the scheduled start and 40–50 minutes after it. The curve is the German 10Y yield less the 2Y yield.
panels.coverage: 3,758 timed communications, 2,426 unique official text matches, 96 scored and 48 eligible for comparison.
notes: Exclude out-of-session or overlapping ECB speech windows, decision days and missing 1Y OIS. A missing German maturity reduces the curve sample.
The ECB workbook supplies changes. The starting OIS level and the probability assigned to the next meeting are unavailable here.

11 of 11 hawkish observations fall in the Christine Lagarde presidency and 26 of 30 dovish observations in the Mario Draghi presidency. Differences in economic conditions and speakers can affect the comparison.

panels.label: Fed Chair speeches · daily Treasury fixings
panels.description: Two consecutive Treasury observations bracket the speech. Each pre-speech measure runs from the fifth prior fixing to the last available pre-speech fixing.
panels.coverage: 410 archived speeches, 65 scored texts, 353 matched daily cross-asset windows and 63 scored eligible windows.
notes: Market history also has 52 eligible scored intraday FX windows. A systematic intraday Treasury or dollar OIS comparison is unavailable in those data.
Quarterly SOFR option distributions cover 13 of these speeches. The underlying horizon is a three-month average. Prior Treasury moves also include term premia.
Daily changes include other news. A single-calendar-day check drops fixings separated by weekends or holidays.

example.title: Powell at Jackson Hole · 25 August 2023
example.description: Powell kept further tightening conditional. The source reports the September hike probability at 19.5% five minutes before the speech and 21.5% 15 minutes afterwards. Under a hold-or-25 bp hike interpretation, that adds 0.50 bp to the expected September move (4.88 to 5.38 bp). In the daily window US 2Y moved +5 bp and 2s10s -3 bp.
